instruction.text: Are the following statements true or false?

atoms.a: Shadows are formed when a transparent object blocks light.
Shadows are the same shape as the object that causes them.
Objects cannot have more than one shadow.
The shadow of an object will move depending on the angle of the light source.
If an object moves closer to a light source, its shadow will be smaller.
If an object moves further away from a light source, its shadow will be smaller.
When the sun is nearer the horizon, the shadow is smaller.
A brick wall can create a shadow.
